author: SilverBullet4869
body:
Hello, I would like you to unban me please. The mod _Poseidon__ has given me a Temperary Ban without warning me that I might be banned forever. I am sorry but if that is allowed then I can't believe that you are doing this. So please unban me I will be respectful next time please give me a last chance to show you I am respectful and I would have never been disrespectful, again if _Poseidon__ warned me that I will be temp banned. Plus I swear I didn't swear for him to ban me I said 1 offensive word then he banned me without getting warned please fix this issue by not making him a mod or by unbanning me I will be respectful next time.

Kind Regards,

ManCityForever

Hello ManCityForever, 

This isn't the place to report modeators. If you have any concerns regarding any moderator please email avicus support at support@avicus.net or talk to a senior moderator. Similarly if you want to appeal an infraction this also isn't the right place to do so, make another thread under the appeal an infraction tab.
